problem.statement_latex: For a polynomial $P:\mathbb F_q^n\to\mathbb F_q$ of fixed degree two or three, an oracle $F(x,y)$ has equal outputs exactly when $y-P(x)$ agrees. Recover the nonconstant coefficients of $P$; the constant term is absorbed by output relabeling.
problem.statement_text: For a polynomial $P:\mathbb F_q^n\to\mathbb F_q$ of fixed degree two or three, an oracle $F(x,y)$ has equal outputs exactly when $y-P(x)$ agrees. Recover the nonconstant coefficients of $P$; the constant term is absorbed by output relabeling.
